final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS player_count FROM fielding AS f LEFT JOIN player AS p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), stats AS (SELECT bats, player_count, SUM(player_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(player_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT bats, player_count, 1.0 * player_count / total_count AS share_of_total, player_count - average_count AS above_average FROM stats WHERE player_count > average_count
